\chapter{A wider school map}
\label{ch:zh-school-compounds}
\hlchaptermodality{15}

\begin{chapteropening}
\textbf{By the end of this chapter:} \emph{I can understand, say, read and write \zh{中学}, \zh{中学生}, \zh{同学} and \zh{上学} after gaining only \zh{中} and \zh{同} through source-verified, gently staged handwriting practice.}

Four official Level 1 school words are retrieved across four spaced reviews, then checked independently in listening, speaking, unassisted reading and no-model writing.
\end{chapteropening}

\section[zhōng]{Hear \emph{zhōng} — middle}

\label{lesson:ZH-C15-hear-zhong}



\begin{quote}
Say \textbf{small} in Mandarin.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{What to know first}
\begin{quote}
\emph{zhōng} — \textbf{middle; centre}
\end{quote}

Hold one high, level tone: \emph{zhōng}. Stay with sound and meaning. The written shape comes next.

\end{tcolorbox}
\section[zhōng]{\zh{中} — close, then pass through}

\label{lesson:ZH-W15-zhong}



\begin{quote}
Say \textbf{middle} in Mandarin.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Script — the shape}
Reuse \zh{口}'s three-stroke box: left side; joined top and right; closing bottom. Only then draw the long centre vertical through the box. Four strokes; three lifts.

\subsection*{Your turn}
Trace \textbf{\zh{中}} once. Copy it once while saying \textbf{box, close, through}.

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Source: \href{https://raw.githubusercontent.com/chanind/hanzi-writer-data/68d10a4b21150cae5e1ebbd223eed289cf32d90c/data/\%E4\%B8\%AD.json}{Hanzi Writer Data \zh{中}, pinned stroke paths and medians}.
\end{tcolorbox}

\section[zhōngxuésheng]{Hear \emph{zhōngxuésheng} — middle-school student}

\begin{quote}
\emph{zhōngxuésheng} — \textbf{middle-school student}

Say three beats: level \emph{zhōng}, rising \emph{xué}, light \emph{sheng}. The shared \emph{xué} is spoken only once.

\section[tóng]{\zh{同} — frame, line, box}

\label{lesson:ZH-W15-tong}



\begin{quote}
Say \textbf{classmate}, then air-write \zh{口}.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Script — the shape}
Draw the outer left side. Lift for the joined outer top and right side, ending with its small hook. Add the inner horizontal. Finish the familiar \zh{口} inside: left, joined top-right, closing bottom. Six strokes; five lifts.

\subsection*{Your turn}
Trace \textbf{\zh{同}} once. Copy it once while saying \textbf{frame, line, box}.

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Source: \href{https://raw.githubusercontent.com/chanind/hanzi-writer-data/68d10a4b21150cae5e1ebbd223eed289cf32d90c/data/\%E5\%90\%8C.json}{Hanzi Writer Data \zh{同}, pinned stroke paths and medians}.
\end{tcolorbox}

\section[Practice]{Payoff — four school compounds in four skills}

\label{lesson:ZH-C15-practice}



\begin{quote}
Write \zh{中}, \zh{同}, \zh{上}, \zh{学}, and \zh{生} without a model.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
1. \textbf{Listening:} hear the four words in mixed order and choose each meaning. 2. \textbf{Speaking:} produce all four from meaning cards, with tones audible. 3. \textbf{Reading:} read all four character cards without pinyin. 4. \textbf{Writing:} hear all four and write them without a model.

Pass each skill separately. Repair and retry only the failed skill.

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Source: \href{https://hsk.cn-bj.ufileos.com/3.0/\%E6\%96\%B0\%E7\%89\%88HSK\%E8\%80\%83\%E8\%AF\%95\%E5\%A4\%A7\%E7\%BA\%B21219.pdf}{Official HSK 3.0 syllabus, Level 1 task outline and vocabulary}.
